newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ridley lifts Joe White bid to A$5.30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ridley lifts Joe White bid to A$5.30.

text.p: Stockfeed supplier Ridley Corp Ltd said on Thursday it would lift its takeover offer for maltster Joe White Maltings Ltd to A$5.30 per share from A$4.85 per share.

Ridley also said it would extend the offer period by two weeks to October 8 and waive the A$5 million capital expenditure condition in relation to Joe White's new Western Australian malting plant which was costed at A$34 million.
Ridley originally bid for Joe White on June 27 with Joe White directors rejecting the offer on July 18 as completely inadequate.

With regard to Ridley's court action seeking disclosure of the valuation advice contained in Joe White's formal Part B rejection, Ridley said the company expected to receive a decision soon but it remained in the interests of both company's
shareholders to keep the matter moving.
By 1.20 p.m. (0320 GMT), Joe White shares were untraded but bid at A$5.30 while Ridley shares were two cents lower at A$1.70 on turnover of 95,715 shares.
